description: Demolition and rebuilding of an existing single storey flat roof ground floor extension, including enlargement alterations to the outrigger ground floor bay window, enlargement of existing outrigger rear first floor windows, and ground floor WC side window, installation of two rooflights to the existing outrigger roof, new refuse and air source heat pump enclosures and accompanying alterations to the front and rear garden boundary walls/fences.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

All new external finishes in respect of all the works hereby approved (and any other incidental works to be carried out in this connection) shall match the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed execution and finished appearance, unless otherwise stated on the drawings hereby approved.REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.

The noise level from all plant and machinery included in the approved development shall at all times remain 10dB(A) below background levels when measured at any nearby residential window.REASON: To ensure that occupiers of neighbouring premises do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance and other excess noise and that noise levels accord with BS 4142.
